questions.q_en: What was the day of the week on 14th March 2010?
questions.solution_en:
Suppose today is 22 August 2023 and day is Tuesday. (We need to take the current date and current day).

Now, we calculate the total number of days from 14 March 2010 to 22 August 2023.

Total days from 14 March 2010 to 22 August 2023 = Total days from 14 March 2010 to 14 March 2023 + Total days from 14 March 2023 to 22 August 2023

Total days from 14 March 2010 to 14 March 2023 = 13 * 365 + 3 (Leap years) = 4745 + 3 = 4748 days

Total days from 14 March 2023 to 22 August 2023 = 31 (March) + 30 (April) + 31 (May) + 30 (June) + 31 (July) + 8 (Remaining days in August) = 161 days

Total days from 14 March 2010 to 22 August 2023 = 4748 + 161 = 4909 days = 701 weeks 2 days

So, the day on 22 August 2023 will be 2 days ahead of the day on 14 March 2010.

Hence, the day on 14 March 2010 was Sunday.
